data.long_meaning:
Riya is a Sanskrit word that means 'joy' or 'pleasure'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'riddhi' which means wealth or prosperity.
Riya is also considered the name of the goddess of wealth and prosperity in Hindu mythology. She is depicted as the goddess of abundance, beauty, and fertility.
